Here's the easiest and best explanation I can give anyone who thinks that the NA Union is something happening soon. Canadians have drastically different tastes in political agendas than the Americans do. For example, Canadians don't give a fuck about if you want to marry the same sex, or even if you want to marry your cousin (you can go through the legal process for the latter). We also don't entirely respect the United States and their view on Geo-Political issues like for example Iraq, Syria, Libya, etc the list goes on. Sure we invaded Iraq and Afghanistan alongside our US brothers but we didn't even come close to the magnitude of fighting that the US found itself in.

In addition to the different views in terms of domestic and geo-political decisions you can ask any Canadian about the American lifestyle and if it's something they wish they had, 90 percent of time and I'd feel safe saying more than 90 percent of the time, the Canadian will say their life in Canada is perfectly fine and wouldn't wish for it to change in any respect; the same can likely be said for Americans, but I don't know since I'm Canadian myself.

There's also points which the user on the original thread pointed at which concern the transnational borders and the problem of dealing with people who aren't welcome in our nation but welcome in the other two nations which would be a part of this deal.

It's a long shot from happening and would have to have something drastic happen on the Geo Political stage like the collapse of the EU and invasion of Mexico by some other nation state.
